about: The known-issues layer (world reader inventory T1): code oddities (docs/reference/how-it-works/oddities.md and the lines removed from it when fixed), trial findings waiting for Cain's yes or no, and parked items. Each names what it touches (check ids, tables, levels, years) and, when fixed, the commit and date of the fix. A book marks an issue live when the world was built before the fix. Edit this file when an oddity is found or fixed.

issues.title: A holdout's camp dip had the wrong sign: holdouts came out of camp in better form, not worse.

Prestige and facilities are stored 0-1 but personnel divides them by 100 and 20, so no FBS staff has more than three personnel posts or a general manager; one public analyst's big-program lean never fires.
Small-school players flagged by the stats footprint get a December read at accuracy 8 instead of 13: a wider error, though the comment says truer.
Grudges came only from waivers, never from trades or releases before the deadline.
A hurt player took a flat -3 on every rating (InjuryKind::hampers was never called).
In-game injury odds ignored fatigue, though the comment says it matters.
In states with a heat rule a note said practice was cut, but the week's work wasn't reduced.
AI college and high school teams had no practice injuries; only your team rolled them.
In the world, wear only rises from major injuries; only the class sim adds wear each season.
RB physical decline starts 2.5 years early; the 1.5 cap only limits late decline.
Coaching a habit through your plan reset the old habit, so nothing slipped back under stress.
Kick orders set ReturnRisk numbers that nothing read.
Nothing calls team_fit or fit_note; the design shows fit notes on the boards.
Every world game used today's rule book: NFL history games played the 2025 kickoff, the 15-yard extra point and the 10-minute overtime.
College overtime never reached the two-point shootout.
The game plan's run-pass lean is saved but never read.
AI coordinators never called designed plays, and legal ignored the level.
Fourth-down choices and in-game EPA used the NFL expected-points table at every level.
call_defense centred belief twice, and the blitz quick-throw term counted prep snaps against this game's throws.
AI teams had no team rules; rule-breaking only ran for your team.
Several pre-draft choices are only words: the testing camp and QB-throws flags, and every department instruction but focus.
Nothing in the AI draft reads injury history: drafted and undrafted prospects should differ in injury history and don't.
Turf (1.12 times the injury risk) was only set in NFL games in closed stadiums.
combine_bench_mean has 13 values for 14 positions and the combine CSV has no long snapper row, so every snapper is 73 in and 230 lb.
Lane 4's picks sized game prep bigger than the code does.
Study hall flagged players under a 2.3 GPA at every level but the practice screen flagged high schoolers only under 2.0.
A player absent from a voluntary week still took the team week's load.
NFL and other-league game injuries are carried by the snap side, not the team, so about half of pro game injuries never carry past the game (update 3 lane 4 extra B1 fixes it).
Dynasties: Georgia 18 and Texas 10 of 31 titles, though Georgia's starters were only 1-3 points ahead (trial 10 finding 1; the dynasties thread is tracing it).
High school scoring: 15.5 points a team game on 4.8 yards a play (real about 26, from memory) (trial 10 finding 2).
No help against the best pass rusher: an 86.5-sack high school season, 222 seasons of 30+ (real record about 40, from memory) (trial 10 finding 3).
The best receiver doesn't get the ball: top high school season 1,134 yards in 13 years (trial 10 finding 4).
High school interceptions: best season 7 (real leaders 10-15) (trial 10 finding 5).
Winning streaks don't end: Mater Dei 248 straight (real record 151) (trial 10 finding 6).
5-stars drafted too often: 87.6% (real 62%) (trial 10 finding 7).
FBS rosters still short: median 86 (real near 105); in-state share 28% (real 37%) (trial 10 finding 8).
NFL scoring (trial 7 finding 1): measured, not tuned, until its feeding systems are settled.
College stat lines (trial 7 finding 2): measured, not tuned.
Dynasties (trial 7 finding 3): measured, not tuned.
NFL trades (trial 7 finding 8): measured, not tuned.
Awards (trial 7 finding 9): measured, not tuned.
Round 1 positions (trial 7 finding 10): measured, not tuned.
